title: Grateful Dead Live at Giants Stadium on 1989-07-10
lineage: MAC > Sony TC-D5M (no Dolby) > Marantz CDR-500 > EAC > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH v.1.0.0.72 (for SBE-OK, FLAC compression, and checksums) > FLAC.
source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell UDXL-IIS 90's, with Dolby off. Mics on stand aprx eight feet high, with foam windscreens on mics, and umbrella secured aprx six inches above the mics. Set up even with the front of the soundboard, to the left (stage right) on Phil's side.

ai_review.summary: Well‑balanced audience recording that handles adverse conditions admirably.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the excellent balance of the tape and commends the recorder for braving difficult conditions with his gear. No specific comments on the musical performance are given, but the positive tone and four‑star rating indicate overall satisfaction with what was captured.
